map.十字交叉法（Pearson 平方）配比：目标含量 T 需介于原料 A、B 含量之: Cross method (Pearson square) for mixture ratios: the target content T must lie between the contents of raw materials A and B. The number of parts of A is |B - T| and of B is |A - T|, and each share is its parts divided by the sum of the parts (the closer T is to one material, the larger the other material part count). Then multiply each share by the total weight to get each raw material weight, and check by back-calculating the blended content as a weighted average.
